description: This file contains unit tests for the KeyNameReviser class, testing immutability and string transformation methods related to JSON key name escaping and decoding.

classes.name: KeyNameReviserTest
classes.description: Unit test class for KeyNameReviser, testing immutability and string escaping/decoding methods.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that the KeyNameReviser class is immutable and that Function interface implementations used within are also immutable.

methods.name: instanceReturnedForEscapingProblematicPlainCharsWorksAsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that the KeyNameReviser.escapeProblematicPlainChars() method correctly replaces problematic characters in JSON key names with Unicode equivalents.

methods.name: instanceReturnedForDecodingKnownUnicodeCharsWorksAsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that the KeyNameReviser.decodeKnownUnicodeChars() method correctly decodes Unicode representations back to original characters in JSON key names.
